text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
They aren't here either... Let's try 
looking somewhere else!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. Is it really necessary to drag 
us into this... just to search for it...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You're telling me to abandon a precious 
experimental sample? You really ought to 
show a bit more interest in my 
experiments.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. It'll be faster if all four of 
us look for it. We're all in this together 
when someone's in trouble. Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"While I was experimenting, it suddenly 
started moving." Agnes Tachyon laughed, 
calling it an unexpected turn of events.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Utterly fascinating! Suddenly, cotton-like 
fluff started spilling from the test tube, 
and before I knew it, I just burst into a 
sprint!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
One shouldn't call that life. I don't 
think it possesses a will; it merely moves 
like clockwork—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Let's name this mysterious object 
'Cotton-kun No. 1'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, running into us by chance, she 
asked us to help with the search."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I hope you find Cotton-kun No. 1 soon...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Top Road-san. Weren't you... heading 
home as well? There was really no need to 
go out of your way to keep me company...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! If I can be of help, that makes 
me happy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. But if it doesn't have a will of its 
own, could it even cause any harm? 
Besides, if it's made of cotton, getting 
hit by it wouldn't hurt anyone.
choice_data_list: Still, who knows what might happen...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Precisely. Cotton-kun No. 1 moving was 
truly an unprecedented event. Which means 
anything that happens from now on is 
completely unpredictable!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? T-This is awful...!
choice_data_list: We'll find it no matter what!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, you say the most amusing things. 
Even if I wanted to give chase, how could 
I when they are nowhere to be seen?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...You really are something else...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
! Look! The floor here... is wet, with 
something like foam on it! Could this be 
from Cotton-kun No. 1!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. It's starting to liquefy. I'd like to 
collect a sample of this too, but... 
Securing the main specimen comes first.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the trail led to the gym storage 
shed. As I carefully looked around—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, that's right! Where haven't we 
checked yet... Ah, the gym storage room! 
We haven't looked there yet, let's go 
check!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, even though it's none of your 
business, you are remarkably dedicated. 
Why not take a page from their book, Cafe?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...No, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"However... I do agree that it's 'none of 
our business.' ...Which is why, Top 
Road-san."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...... ...No. It's... nothing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The PE storage room was dead silent. As I 
cautiously looked around—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...There are.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh, where to—... Gasp!? Cafe-chan, look 
out!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A white mass lunged at Manhattan Cafe—no, 
at Narita Top Road, who had jumped in to 
protect her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Kya...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Yet, right before that happened, 
Cotton-kun No. 1 was suddenly yanked, as 
if pulled by something, right over Agnes 
Tachyon's head—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And turned into water.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... That gave me quite a fright. Is 
everyone unhurt? I'll bring some towels 
right away—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...... Top Road-san.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Why did you protect me? Something 
terrible... could have happened to you...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Ah, I'm sorry. I made you worry, 
didn't I? Um... I just didn't have time to 
stop and think about why.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Before I knew it, my body just moved. 
Ahaha."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...You are...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
... ...I see. So you're straightforward... 
in things other than running, too...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...No. I only said... thank you... 
...From me... and from my 'friend'..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Cafe-chan... Fufu, not at all! You're 
very welcome!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, 'friends', is it? That explains 
why Cotton-kun No. 1 mysteriously turned 
into water above my head... *achoo*."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It had been a hectic afternoon after 
school, but seeing Narita Top Road's smile 
at the end brought a sigh of relief.
